author: Nerdstalgic
description:
Red Skull could have been one of the MCU's greatest villains. So why did Marvel waste him?

Introduced back in Captain America: The First Avenger, Johann Schmidt had almost everything Marvel would later look for in a great recurring antagonist. He was powerful, memorable, ideologically opposed to Captain America, and played brilliantly by Hugo Weaving.

But instead of becoming a major force in the MCU, Red Skull slowly disappeared from the franchise.  And when Red Skull finally returned nearly a decade later, it wasn't quite the comeback fans had been waiting for.

Because Marvel didn't just have a great villain on their hands.  They had a villain who could have become more relevant with every phase of the MCU.

#marvel #captainamerica #redskull #mcu
title: How Marvel Wasted Red Skull
